messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staged rollout v4.2.3 -> 7% (regions: global). Initiator: priya. Cmd: `/deploy start --version v4.2.3 --percent 7 --note "quantization perf + tokenizer parity"`

priya: Launching canary. Preflight OK. Change window 03:00-06:00 UTC. I'll watch p50/p95/p99 and tokenization errors.

dan: QA smoke passed. Noting quantization paths changed for int8 on newer hosts — watch for CPU offload and latency shift on longer sequences.

infra-bot: ALERT: na-west slowtail latency increase p99 +210ms (baseline +40ms). Error rate still low. Traces point to increased CPU blocking on model-host-21 around kv-cache flush.

meera: seeing same in dashboards. It's a tail effect on long-sequence requests (>600 tokens). Suggest PAUSE and scope pin for NA-West until we triage.

priya: Agree HOLD for NA-West. Do not bump further. We should decide between: (A) routing long-sequence requests to legacy quant path, (B) revert quantization patch, or (C) full rollback. Preference: low-risk routing opt first.

ops-sre: Vote: HOLD. Pin NA-West. Rollback criteria: sustained p99 > 300ms for 5m OR error spikes >0.5% for 3m. If triggered, rollback cmd: `/deploy rollback --version v4.2.2 --percent 100`. Also document temporary routing option: `/routing set --service generation --predicate "seq_len>600" --target v4.2.2-quant --scope na-west`

dan: I'll open a routing-change PR to divert long runs to the legacy quant variant. That should be quick and minimize customer impact. If routing doesn't help, we'll revert quant change.

prod-support: Please draft a short blurb we can share to customers if asked. Keep it non-technical.

priya: Draft for support: "We are investigating intermittent latency for a small portion of long requests in NA-West after a platform update. Engineers are triaging and working on a mitigation."

infra-bot: NOTE: CPU steal and GC events correlate with the slow tail. model-host-21 shows sporadic GC pauses after quant lib update.

meera: routing PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/5210 — switches seq_len>600 to legacy quant. CI running. ETA deploy if green ~8-12m.

ops-sre: If PR is green, approve targeted routing apply to na-west only. Keep rollout pinned until we confirm 10m stability. If routing fails, plan to revert quantization commit (PR #5208) and prepare rollback as last resort.

deploy-bot: Action recorded: `/release pin v4.2.3 --scope na-west --reason "na-west slowtail p99 increase" --initiator priya`. Percent bumps disabled for pinned scope.

meera: CI green and staging smoke looks good for routing change. Recommend apply to NA-West now.

deploy-bot: Routing change applied: seq_len>600 -> v4.2.2-quant (scope: na-west). Propagation ongoing (~30s).

infra-bot: NOTE: post-apply p99 trending down toward baseline. Continue to monitor for 15m.

priya: If stable for 15m we'll unpin NA-West and resume bumping the rollout (next step 20%). Postmortem owner if rollback needed: meera.

prod-support: Support blurb posted to #support. Oncall notified.

ops-sre: Documenting decision: routing-first mitigation worked; keep quantization revert PR ready as contingency. Set reminder to schedule a follow-up to analyze quant lib behavior on long sequences and add a targeted regression test for seq_len>600.

priya: Unpinning NA-West after 18m of stable metrics. Resuming staged rollout to 20% for NA-West. Thanks everyone. :tada:
